title: Unsupported actions/setup-node runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the selected Node.js version, registry authentication, and dependency-cache behavior.

steps.title: Upgrade setup-node
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/setup-node@v5 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review runtime and cache inputs
steps.instructions: Confirm node-version, registry-url, cache, and cache-dependency-path remain valid for the target release.
